objective: determine whether a noise-dependent optimal Trotter step count minimises the total simulation error

configuration.hamiltonian: H = -J sum Z_iZ_{i+1} - h sum X_i
configuration.noise_convention: p_1 and p_2 are total non-identity Pauli probabilities per gate; p_g is applied once per Trotter step and is not comparable to p_1 or p_2
configuration.note: noise parameters are illustrative simulation parameters, not measured hardware error rates
